module: "Pacenotes" sub-window of the race editor (raceEditor). It lets you list, select, create (Shift + drag in the world to set position, radius and direction), move with the gizmo, and delete pacenotes of the current path (path.pacenotes). Actions go through editor.history (undo/redo). The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/raceEditor/pacenotes')(raceEditor).
notes: This window is commented out in raceEditor.lua (table.insert ... pacenotes): it is not loaded in game 0.40.5.
C:selectPacenote tests self.note, a field that is never set in this file; if it were set, the function would call itself indefinitely. C:onEditModeActivate also tests self.note.
C:selector indexes segments.objects[node[fieldName]]: with the value -1 ("None") the entry does not exist in the table, which would cause an error on .name.

C.desc: Pacenotes window. Created by the constructor returned by the module, with init(raceEditor). windowDescription = 'Pacenotes'. The methods are called by raceEditor.lua (setPath, selected, unselect, draw, onEditModeActivate).

init.desc: Initializes the window: stores raceEditor, selection index nil and empty mouseInfo.

setPath.desc: Sets the race path (gameplay/race/path) being edited.

selected.desc: Called when the tab becomes active: deselects, draws pacenotes in "normal" mode, segments in "faded" mode, adds the Shift shortcut "Add New" and fetches the navigation map (map.getMap()).

unselect.desc: Called when the tab is left: hides pacenotes (_drawMode = 'none') and removes the Shift shortcut.

selectPacenote.desc: Selects the pacenote with ID id (nil for none). See notes on the recursive call conditional on self.note.

updateTransform.desc: Places the axis gizmo on the pacenote at the given index, oriented along its normal in local alignment. No effect if the gizmo is not allowed.

beginDrag.desc: Start of gizmo manipulation: stores the serialized state, rotation and radius of the pacenote (navRadiusScale in navgraph mode).

dragging.desc: During manipulation: applies gizmo translation (pos), rotation (normal) or scaling (radius, never negative) to the pacenote.

endDragging.desc: End of manipulation: commits the "Manipulated Note via Gizmo" history action (before/after via onSerialize/onDeserialized).

onEditModeActivate.desc: Called when the race edit mode is activated (see notes).

draw.desc: Called every frame: stores mouseInfo, handles gizmo and inputs if allowed, then draws the list and the detail panel.

mouseInfo.desc: Mouse info (valid, down, up, hold, camPos, rayDir, rayCast, _downPos, _holdPos, _upPos).

createManualPacenote.desc: Displays the creation help and the preview (sphere, prisms) during the drag, then on release creates a manual pacenote (radius 5 if the drag is ≤ 1 m) via history; the direction is given by the drag.

mouseOverPacenotes.desc: Returns the pacenote whose sphere is crossed by the mouse ray, the one closest to the camera.

input.desc: Handles the mouse: with Shift, manual creation; otherwise click on a pacenote to select it (or none).

drawPacenoteList.desc: Draws the sorted pacenote list (+ "New..." entry) and the current pacenote panel (delete, move, fields).

selector.desc: Dropdown to choose a segment (or "None" = -1) in a field of the current pacenote, with a history action.

fieldName.desc: Modified pacenote field (contains a segment ID).
